steps.title: Analyze and Plan UI Overhaul
steps.description: Inspect and map out spacing, color harmony, rounded corners, and structural constraints for the entire user interface.

steps.description: Enhance gradient_header.xml with high-end luxury deep indigo (#1E1B4B) to rich royal indigo (#4F46E5) gradient tones.

steps.title: Enhance Card BG Styling
steps.description: Improve rounded corners and subtle border strokes on cards to create a premium, tactile material appearance.

steps.title: Revamp Primary and Accent Buttons
steps.description: Polish button backgrounds with professional gradients, press states, and balanced color values.

steps.title: Redesign Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Update activity_main.xml with more spacious padding, professional text sizes, beautiful alignments, and sleek drop shadows.

steps.title: Upgrade Task Item UI
steps.description: Optimize list items for scheduled tasks with better spacing, robust alignment, and beautiful badge representation.

steps.title: Upgrade Subject Item UI
steps.description: Refactor registered courses modules layout with clean left margin indicators and streamlined action buttons.

steps.title: Refine Task Scheduling Dialog Sheet
steps.description: Upgrade the dialog_add_task.xml layouts to have high readability, structured margins, and unified text sizes.

steps.title: Verify Code References in MainActivity

steps.title: Building Study Planner Pro
